answer: We prove Sybil resistance via dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices as core cryptoeconomic primitives. Requiring staking collateral with rapid slashing penalties builds a capital barrier proving the expected payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative, neutralizing ivory arrays of fake nodes. Thus, zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces asymmetric punishment, driving Nash equilibrium convergence as rational adversaries reject pigment-based Sybil attacks, collapsing the juniper topology into robust consensus.
